body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature you can perceive declares an Action that targets you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Gain +1 Defense against the triggering Action. You may gain 1 Strain to move 1 unit before it resolves.

surges.html: After this Reaction resolves, gain +1 Defense against the next Action from the same source before your next turn.
Until your next turn, you always know the triggering creature's location while it remains within 5 units.
